verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition. The two text pairs are staggered at arbitrary x positions, the divider line sits beside 'When Life Is Great' when it should separate the two pairs, and the rose is cut off by a hard vertical edge at mid-canvas, leaving the whole right and lower-right half empty. B keeps the original's order, centring and divider, but it is just the narrow original column dropped into the middle of a wide canvas: the rose strip has visible straight crop edges, the wide side margins are empty, and the text is small for the format. It is not rearranged for the new shape, but it is coherent and on brand.
